children.source: w => { visits += 1; if stop { return w.emit("[stop]") }; w.emit("[keep]"); visits += 10 }
w => { for n in 0..<4 { if n == limit { return }; visited += 1; w.emit(n.to_string()) }; w.emit("done") }
w => { for n in 0..<6 { if n == 1 { continue }; if n == 4 { break }; w.emit(n.to_string()) }; w.emit("done") }
w => { guard value is Some(n) else { return w.emit("none") }; match n { 0 => return w.emit("zero"); _ => w.emit(n.to_string()) }; w.emit("done") }
w => { defer w.emit("D1"); defer w.emit("D2"); w.emit("B"); if stop { return }; w.emit("E") }
w => { defer w.emit("defer"); w.emit("body"); if stop { raise CallbackError }; w.emit("ok") }
